### Rhythmic Purgatory { #awakening-rhythmic-purgatory }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/oto/rhythmic_purgatory.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Fills the area with a deadly beat that builds up pressure on every enemy inside with each beat, then the beat drops and they take damage for all of it. Enemies that can't hear are not affected.

### Grand Finale { #awakening-grand-finale }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/oto/grand_finale.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Sends a big wall of sound forward that goes through everything and hits every enemy that hears it. Used on the beat it deals 50% more damage.

<!-- move awakenawakennomi:on_the_beat -->

### On the Beat { #awakening-on-the-beat }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/oto/on_the_beat.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

The user fights to a steady beat, hits that land on the beat deal bonus damage that goes up with every beat in a row. A blow off the beat breaks the combo.
